verdict.rationale: vllm-docs-8 directly claims tool calling and reasoning parser support, and vllm-docs-9 confirms an OpenAI-compatible API server which is the typical delivery mechanism for tool-calling requests. However, there's no detail on which models/parsers are supported, no independent/community corroboration of tool-calling working in practice, and no example request format shown. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of tool-calling and reasoning-parser behavior, documentation detail on supported parser formats/models, example API usage.
